scope: Search-time UI controls only, no mutation of entity/link corpora

glossary.radius_by_type: Max admitted number of steps along certified paths from original search root to a VISIBLE node of that type; 0 hides type, 1 means direct only. Global max V.
glossary.selected_branch_depth_by_type: Number of additional certified steps when an individual node of the named type is deliberately selected as a pivot: 0..III. This DOES NOT auto-expand every node of that class.
glossary.terminal_context: Historical context is visible (if relevant to the original search root) but has no outgoing traversal in that search; selecting it as a new ROOT starts a distinct search.
glossary.root_exception: The searched entity is always visible regardless of its type cap and can show its verified immediate neighbours, including when its type is terminal in other searches.

hard_rules.historical_periods: Only direct verified association with the current search ROOT. Always terminal when non-root; no path through period to other persons.
hard_rules.historical_geography: No automatic bridges through shared country, city or institution; explicit certified edges only and default terminal.
hard_rules.generic_genre: A generic genre/form/school never proves links among all composers practising it; non-root genre remains terminal without a deliberate pivot action.
hard_rules.editorial_chapters: Always excluded from historical graph, available separately as editorial resources.
hard_rules.external_resources: Site anchors, videos, audio, bibliography, catalogue links and metadata belong to nodes/edges as references. They never consume or generate historical graph depth.
hard_rules.source_preservation: Preserve original node URLs; all exact anchors from collegamenti-sito.json, audio/video records and associations, consultazione.json, and relation forward/reverse/note/sources/status/group.
hard_rules.history_gates: No predicate is admitted simply because nodes share a time period, geographical origin, genre, evidence URL or nominal similarity.
hard_rules.audit: No global historical_verified or relevance flags inferred from existing tier/status; explicit evidence mapping is separate.

caveats: Initial type membership needs audit: Mundi `corrente` includes genres, schools, institutions and more; Atlantis `nodo-di-senso` holds many subtypes and cannot be mapped by category alone.
These are suggested defaults, not approved final values; allow user per-search overrides and later custom saved presets.
Default is 2 for a manually selected person/work pivot, user may set 1, 2 or 3; no mass autoexpansion.
Potentially relevant historical periods must be attested as direct links to the CURRENT search root, not inherited from displayed authors.
Graph must retain distinct directed predicates, multiple edges, provenance, and exact media/site-anchor references.
